w:r.w:t: File: muse-prototype-v2.html · Updated: June 23, 2026 · Status: In Review

Redesigned subscription screen with three plans: Weekly ($9.99 / 800 credits), Monthly ($29.99 / 4,000 credits), Yearly ($69.99 / 8,000 credits). Purple glow background and six feature list items with SVG icons. Switching plans animates the credit count with ease-out cubic (480 ms); credits label fades in after the animation completes. Subscribe CTA opens an Apple Pay confirmation sheet with plan summary, price, and Face ID button.
After subscribing: subscription success toast appears above the tab bar. NavBar crown button and Account Upgrade button subsequently route to the Buy Credits screen instead of IAP.
Added a “Create” pill button to storyboard Done rows. Tapping navigates to Edit Storyboard (same action as tapping the row). Button has no border stroke.

Redesigned edit input sheet to match Figma: drag handle at top; header row with dark X pill (28×28 px, left), bold centered title, and purple checkmark circle (28×28 px, right); full-width textarea inside a card; inline character counter and × clear button at bottom-right. Slide-up/fade transition aligned with all other bottom sheets.
Song thumbnail row is now tappable. Play icon toggles to pause icon while playing; resets automatically on screen navigation.
Added new read-only “Story” section below Visual Style. Uses darker background (--n14), no border, and muted text colour to visually distinguish from editable fields.

Renamed “Synopsis” section to “Story Line”. Added Scene 4. Removed per-scene edit icon buttons; tapping the card directly opens the editor. Added expand/collapse chevron in section header (white, full opacity).

Added new read-only “Lyrics” section at the bottom. Scrollable (max-height 160 px, hidden scrollbar). Each lyric line prefixed with a timecode ([mm:ss:00]) in muted colour. Same read-only visual style as Story.
Removed “Default Quality” item. Added “Settings” item (ic_settings.svg) that navigates to the new Settings screen. Standardised icon background colour across all list items.

New Settings screen with back button and centred title. List items: Terms of Use (ic_file_text.svg), Privacy Policy (ic_shield_check.svg), Unsubscribe (ic_calendar_x.svg), Delete Account (ic_user_x.svg), Sign Out (ic_log_out.svg). No divider between Delete Account and Sign Out.

Added confirmation dialog matching Sign Out style. Red “Delete” confirm button. Body copy: “All your MVs, songs, and credits will be permanently lost and cannot be recovered. Please cancel any active subscriptions before deleting your account.”
Credit history screen with balance card and transaction list (All / Spend / Earn tabs). Spend rows show action type, timestamp, and delta in white; Earn rows show delta in gold.
Four credit packs (100 / $0.99, 300 / $2.49, 600 / $4.49, 1,000 / $6.49); selected pack highlights in amber. Buy Now opens Apple Pay; on success returns to Credits Detail with a toast.

as certificate background with text content overlaid. Fixed footer link visibility. Added iOS keyboard simulation in keyboard-open state. Updated certificate layout to match Figma (node 479-6937). Set 48 px inner padding on certificate paper.
Added user avatar and username to New Songs and Top Picks Songs rows alongside social stats.
Added Songs tab with a song list including playback, social stats, and action buttons.
Added community user avatar and username display.
Added community user avatar and username display.
Added Instrumental toggle to both Simple and Custom modes. In Simple mode the description textarea remains editable when the toggle is on.
Added community liked items to the Liked tab. Community items are hidden from All, Songs, and Music Videos tabs and show only Like and Share in the option menu.

Added Edit MV and Get Proof CTA buttons to the MV option menu. Added Publish flow to both MV and Song menus: MV shows a confirmation dialog (“Ready to Go Public?”) and an in-review state with timer icon before publishing; Song publishes directly. Both show a success toast on completion and restore the Delete option on unpublish.
Adjusted empty state position and sign-in sheet button sizes to improve accessibility.
Added Upgrade button to Muse Pro list and a divider between Muse Pro and Notifications sections.
Updated trending card 2 to MV type. Redesigned feature cards: removed subtitle text, reduced height to 68px.
Added Like and Share action buttons to every song list row.
Added Liked filter tab. Added More (…) button to each history row with a context-aware option menu (
ike, Share, Publish, Download, Delete) that adapts based on item type and status.
Added Cover Image (9:16 ratio with fullscreen viewer), Cover Description section (inline regenerate + input sheet), and Delete this Project button.
Added new Proof of Creation screen. Accessible via Get Proof in the History option menu for completed Song and MV items.
Added trending carousel (3 cards, drag interaction, auto-slide). Redesigned feature cards with reduced height and updated layout.
Added New Songs paginated carousel and Top Picks Songs horizontal scroll.
Drag-based vertical feed with 3 sample MVs, playback controls, and sound toggle.
Full-bleed player screen with waveform visualiser, playback controls, Like, Share, and Use in Music Video actions.
Two creation modes: Simple (genre + mood + description) and Custom (full lyric editor with section labels).
Initial history screen with creation list, status badges, and All / Music Videos / Songs filter tabs.
Profile screen with stats, Muse Pro status, settings toggles, and Edit Profile sheet.
Subscribe screen with plan toggle, feature list, and 7-day free trial CTA.
2-column masonry layout with portrait and landscape card variants.
Out of Scope — Not in This Version
Real backend integration — all data and media are placeholder assets.
